references: Cyberpunk street setting under crony capitalism and tyranny
Grand Theft Auto as traversal-fantasy inspiration
Jet Set Radio as skating and bold street-presentation inspiration
inspiration.not_included: No franchise assets, maps, costumes, logos, UI, or copied character silhouettes.

visual_proposal_location: BUILD_GUIDE.md art direction. Flat colors in this build are a stand-in, not a cel-shaded style.
hopeful_core: Zero leads an underground resistance that includes AI members. Zero and Fony cooperate to promise and build a better future.

protagonist.situation: Forcibly orphaned by a corrupt system, flees drones, is rescued by the resistance, and can become a hero. The exact orphaning and the opening sequence are not fixed.

world.future_missions: Fictional sabotage and disabling of drones, including in-fiction virus actions, are future game mechanics only. They are not real cyber tools and they are not in this pass.

hq_now: Use the arcade cabinet placeholder and return

zero: You got here. That is enough for tonight. The park is a promise we keep with our own hands.
Fony is at the arcade. The cabinet is only a training shell. The future is the part we build.
fony: Zero holds the line. I hold the door. We are on the same promise.
Skate the warm park. The cold shops are the edge of someone else's city. We do not own that story yet.

optional_suggestions_not_in_this_build: An opening sequence that is still unwritten and contains no graphic trauma scene
An extra singer, only if later confirmed and cleared
More neighborhoods linked by skate routes, including data-center compounds as places
A real Bars per Watt cabinet after an arcade adapter exists
Cel-shaded silhouettes and original graffiti, which are a visual proposal rather than this greybox
Tricks beyond one straight grind rail
Touch controls if a mobile target is chosen later
